message: ナナカは見た！

name: Nanaka
message: 「Fwaaaah...」
She looks sleepy again today.

name: Paqy
message: 「Master Synn. You've got something prepared, don't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Right! Here, take this」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Uhh... w-what is this?」

name: Synn
message: 「...W-well, this is, um, you see」
Hey, Synn, what are you getting all flustered for.
You're just handing Nanaka a little something!

name: Synn
message: 「U-use this!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-whaaaaat! Shiiiiin is giving me a p-p-present!?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-it's really not a big enough deal to call a present」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I'm happy, really, but I can't accept it! I know all about how tight your wallet is, Synn! So I can't just happily take it, or rather」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine, I grew this myself!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You did?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's herbal tea made from chamomile I raised in the garden. If you drink this before bed, it'll calm your nerves and help you get plenty of sleep」
Ah, man, I'm talking way too fast.

name: Synn
message: 「Y-you know, you've been yawning a lot lately, Nanaka, so, um」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Synn. Thank you」
I-I'm getting embarrassed!

name: Synn
message: 「U-uhh, r-really, it's nothing special!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's not true! Thanks!」

name: Synn
message: 「Use this to sleep tight over the weekend, okay」

name: Nanaka
message: 「This is the first time you've ever given me anything, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「...Is... it? Oh, maybe it is...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm gonna treasure it! I'll put it on display on the family altar! Since it's my very first present from you, Synn!」
I didn't know it would make her this happy...
And seeing Nanaka so happy makes me feel just as glad...

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, s-sorry. Did I get a little too excited and creep you out?」

name: Synn
message: 「U-umm, well, rather than just treasuring it, I'd really like you to use it...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-yeah, you're right. Herbal tea is meant to be drunk, after all. Ahaha」

name: Ria
message: 「So, what did you want to talk about?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai and Misaki-senpai are really close, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「Just between you and me, though... actually, we're not」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!? Really!?」

name: Ria
message: 「There's a lot going on between the Kujo and Misaki families, you see. We have to act like we get along for appearances' sake」

name: Synn
message: 「T-there were dark circumstances like that behind it all?! What am I supposed to believe in anymore!」

name: Ria
message: 「Just kidding~」

name: Synn
message: 「What if--just hypothetically--Misaki-senpai was keeping a secret from you, Ria-senpai? How would you feel?」

name: Ria
message: 「Do you think friends shouldn't have any secrets from each other, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, no, I wouldn't say that, but...」

name: Ria
message: 「If someone is keeping a secret from you, does that mean you can't be friends with them anymore?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, no, not necessarily」

name: Ria
message: 「Right? Everybody has a secret or two. Me included, and Ayashiki-chan too」

name: Ria
message: 「Or rather, the longer and deeper you get to know someone, the more things you don't know about them--or secrets, I guess you could say--start piling up」

name: Ria
message: 「I think being friends means accepting each other, secrets and all」

name: Synn
message: 「What if it's an unforgivable secret that they kept quiet about?」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm sure... there's no such thing as an unforgivable secret」

name: Synn
message: 「Is... that so?」

name: Ria
message: 「There are plenty of other things too, but to give you one example--Ayashiki-chan never talks about her family at all. Not about her parents, or any siblings either」

name: Ria
message: 「I think there's probably something going on」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't you want to know? Doesn't it bother you」

name: Ria
message: 「It does bother me, sure, but I don't feel like prying into it myself」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that because you're scared?」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm not scared. How should I put it... I just think that someday, Ayashiki will tell me on her own」

name: Ria
message: 「It might be something really heavy, and there might not be anything I can do about it. Even so, I'm not scared」

name: Ria
message: 「Because I believe that after listening to her whole story, I'll be able to say 'thank you'」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you?」

name: Ria
message: 「'Thank you for telling me'」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gah! Those words are way too good for that black-stockinged chick! Yours truly wants to spill a secret to Ria and have her sweetly and gently say 'thank you' too!」

name: Ria
message: 「That said, I don't have any basis for it, I might not even be able to hear her out to the end, and if it actually happens, I might end up cutting ties with her」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, it's true that this is how I feel right now」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn, do you hate that Nanaka is keeping a secret from you?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not that I hate it, but... wait, how did you know?!」

name: Ria
message: 「I can tell. Lately, you've been constantly worrying about Nanaka, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't mean to act like that, though」

name: Ria
message: 「Even if you didn't mean to, that's how it is」

name: Synn
message: 「No way」

name: Ria
message: 「I can tell. Your eyes follow her. Always」
Is that really true...

name: Synn
message: 「I know even Nanaka has a secret or two. Even so, I just can't help letting it bother me」

name: Ria
message: 「What about before now?」

name: Synn
message: 「This is the first time Nanaka has ever kept a secret from me」

name: Ria
message: 「The first time?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes.」

name: Ria
message: 「I don't think that's true. She has at least one secret.」

name: Ria
message: 「I bet it's a secret she's been keeping for a really long time.」

name: Synn
message: 「H-How do you know something like that?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Maybe because I'm a girl too?」

name: Synn
message: 「Is it no good for me because I'm a boy?」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm sure you just didn't notice because Nanaka-chan has always been way too close to you, Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Maybe you're right.」

name: Synn
message: 「How should I put it... Even when we were physically apart, it felt like we were always together. Completely naturally.」

name: Ria
message: 「You've even been in the same class the whole time, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「But lately, it feels like that's not the case... Like Nanaka is Nanaka, and I'm me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Like we weren't actually together at all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is it weird for me to only realize something like this now?」

name: Ria
message: 「I think it's a good thing.」

name: Synn
message: 「But... wanting to know something the other person is trying to keep secret...」

name: Ria
message: 「It just means you've started looking at Nanaka-chan properly, Synn-kun.」
...Have I not been looking at Nanaka...?
Maybe so. No, that must have been the case.

name: Ria
message: 「Because you're looking at her properly, you realized she's her own girl, so you can't just feel at ease anymore. You end up worrying about her.」

name: Ria
message: 「Took you long enough. You have to make sure you watch over her properly, okay?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What were you talking about with Ria-senpai?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I saw you two when I passed by the field earlier.」

name: Synn
message: 「Just talking things over」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Am I not good enough?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yeah, kind of」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, I am just an unreliable Crusaders after all」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not what I meant」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then what did you mean!」

name: Synn
message: 「Like I said, I was just asking for some advice」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I already know you have a thing for Senior Ria, Synn」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's with that, acting all innocent!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not like that at all!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka. What's wrong? You're acting weird」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-If it's just for advice, that's fine. Just advice」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Sorry... I don't know what got into me」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm being weird... Even though I knew you and Senior Ria were just talking for a bit... why...」
